scenicChapters.title: Lake Tahoe Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 15 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Lake Tahoe Loop

road-lake-tahoe-loop.story: Out of South Lake Tahoe and back again: 108 km, roughly 1 h 48 in the saddle. The stops in between: Emerald Bay, Tahoe City and Incline Village. The highest point is about 2,250 m.

scenicChapters.title: Campos do Jordão Climb
scenicChapters.narrative: For 15 km this is Campos do Jordão Climb, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Campos do Jordão Climb
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 48 km. 1038 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.

scenicChapters.title: Campos do Jordão Climb
scenicChapters.narrative: 30 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

campos-do-jordao-climb.story: From Taubaté it runs 92 km to Campos do Jordão; allow about 1 h 46 of riding. The highest point is 1,628 m. The line favours views over speed.
